now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#13
now.text: Lance Hunter becomes close friends with Mack and Bobbi Morse on a mission in Dubai. When Hunter later catches the two of them keeping secrets, Mack brings him aboard Robert Gonzales' carrier to explain.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend, who catches Mack and Bobbi keeping secrets.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend, who brings Hunter aboard Gonzales' carrier to explain.

proposed.text: Mack locks Hunter in a S.H.I.E.L.D. safe house, brings him pizza and a beer, and reminisces about the Dubai mission where they and Bobbi first met. He then hands Hunter, blindfolded, over to the "real S.H.I.E.L.D."

changes.evidence: In One of Us (S2#13) Mack holds the knocked-out Hunter at a safe house, brings him pizza and beer, and they reminisce about the Dubai mission where they and Morse first met (a past event, not one that happens here); Mack then blindfolds him for extraction by the 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.'. Hunter catching Mack and Bobbi keeping secrets is the end tag of Who You Really Are (S2#12), and his introduction aboard Gonzales' carrier is Love in the Time of Hydra (S2#14).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#12
now.text: Vin-Tak, a Kree warrior, comes to Earth to wipe out the power of the Inhumans and sees Skye as a weapon that must be destroyed. He hunts her through the Playground until Sif and Coulson's team stop him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A Kree warrior who hunts Daisy as a weapon to destroy.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman Vin-Tak sees as a weapon that must be destroyed.

proposed.text: Vin-Tak, a Kree warrior who comes to Earth to destroy the Diviners and those they change, sees Skye as a weapon that must be destroyed. He hunts her through the Playground until Fitz blasts him and Bobbi wipes his memory with his own truncheon.

changes.evidence: In Who You Really Are (S2#12) Sif does not stop Vin-Tak: she and Vin-Tak form an uneasy alliance against Skye, Sif wanting to take her to Asgard. Vin-Tak is stopped when Fitz shoots him with the Destroyer prototype gun and Bobbi erases his memory with his truncheon.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#13
now.text: Gordon has little patience for Calvin Zabo, telling him he is no Inhuman, just a science experiment. He warps Cal away before he can kill Coulson, and later captures him to end his war on S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman who calls Cal a science experiment and finally captures him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Daisy's father. Gordon scorns him and finally captures him to end his war on S.H.I.E.L.D.

proposed.text: Gordon teleports Cal out of his standoff with Coulson at Manitowoc, saying he draws too much attention. He tells Cal he is not one of them, just a science experiment.

changes.evidence: In One of Us (S2#13) Gordon's teleport at the stadium is the capture itself (he takes Cal to Afterlife and locks him in a room); there is no later, separate capture. Cal was about to have Angar scream to incapacitate people, not kill Coulson. Gordon then says Cal is making too much noise and is 'not one of us... just a science experiment'.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
now.text: Bobbi Morse rescues Robert Gonzales during the battle for the Iliad and stays loyal to his S.H.I.E.L.D. afterward. He sends her to spy on Coulson's team, and she recommends the raid on Coulson's base.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Bobbi's boss, whom she rescues on the Iliad and spies for.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Gonzales' loyal agent, who rescues him and spies on Coulson.

proposed.text: During the Hydra Uprising, Bobbi helps rescue the wounded Gonzales on the Iliad and fights beside him to retake the ship instead of sinking it. Now his loyal agent, she steals Coulson's toolbox and opens his base to Gonzales' raid.

changes.evidence: Bobbi telling the council she can take Coulson's base in six hours is in Love in the Time of Hydra (S2#14), not this stage's One Door Closes (S2#15). In S2#15 the Iliad flashback shows Bobbi, Hartley and Mack saving Gonzales and retaking the ship, and in the present Bobbi steals the toolbox and lets Gonzales' agents take the base.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
now.text: Phil Coulson recruits Lance Hunter as a mercenary, and Hunter becomes one of his most loyal agents. When Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. takes over, Hunter signs on for good and goes on the run with Coulson.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The director who recruits Hunter and whom he follows on the run.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A mercenary Coulson recruits, who becomes one of his most loyal agents.

proposed.text: After Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. seizes the Playground, Hunter meets the escaped Coulson and signs a napkin as his contract, becoming a permanent agent to help retake the base.

changes.evidence: The first sentence recaps Shadows (S2#1), already the pair's stage 0. What happens between them in One Door Closes (S2#15) is the end tag: Coulson meets Hunter, who signs a napkin as his contract and agrees to become a permanent agent to help retake the Playground.
